messages:
Oncall Bot: PagerDuty alert — elevated 5xx rate on model-runtime-prod (us-west-2). Rule: runtime_5xx_rate > 50 for 5m. Route: /v1/generate (model: redwood-rlhf-v1). Incident INC-3111. Please acknowledge: /ack INC-3111
Sam H: acked and picking this up. I’m oncall.
Sam H: Quick summary: customers see 502/504 + timeouts. Spike started ~3111112000. model-runner pods are crash-looping on several nodes.
Infra SRE: I’m seeing OOM + SIGSEGV on gpu-usw2-34. dmesg tail:```[3111112215.123] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 79, pid=21456, GPU 0: ChID 00000000 submitted preemption command``````[3111112216.456] kernel: quant_kern.so[21456]: segfault at 0 ip 00007f8a3a1b2c dmesg: RIP: 0x7f8a3a1b2c```
Runtime Eng: Runtime logs show repeated "KV cache allocation failed" then immediate segfault in llama_kv.c:742. Stacktrace attached in logs.
Maria G: Support ops — initial triage: two enterprise customers reporting ~30% failures, one reporting large latency spikes. CS contacted.
Sam H: Mitigation plan (short):
- divert small fraction of traffic to backup model variant (redwood-rlhf-v1-small-quant)
- enable kernel compatibility fallback on affected pods
- reduce batch size / batching window on routing layer
- reimage problem node(s) with newer driver
I’ll execute in that order.
Sam H: Running checks: `kubectl get pods -n runtime | grep runner` shows 6/12 runner pods CrashLoopBackOff.
Sam H: Patch to routing: `rbacctl route modify /v1/generate --model-split primary:65 backup:35 --reason "INC-3111 temporary split"`
Runtime Eng: Applying runtime flag to enable fallback kernels: `--kernel-mode=compatibility` on the deployment. Rolling restart in progress.
Infra SRE: Started reimage of gpu-usw2-34 (driver update 530.41 -> 535.86). Draining node and cordoning.
Runtime Eng: Also disabling aggressive KV-prefetch in the batcher config to avoid peak allocs: `batcher.max_batch_size=32 -> 16; batcher.max_wait_ms=25 -> 10`.
Sam H: Observing metrics: error-rate decreased from 124 events/min -> ~28 events/min after routing + kernel-fallback. Latency still elevated for some requests.
Support Ops: Notifying affected customers with interim note. No evidence of data loss or exfil.
Maria G: CS update posted: "We are mitigating elevated errors and routing to fallback model. We'll update again in 30m."
Infra SRE: Reimage finished. Node back and pods rescheduled. One pod reported a different failure: `cudaErrorLaunchFailure` — pulling logs.
Runtime Eng: Found a reproducible crash pattern when quant_kern.so gets mixed ABI from newer driver + old build. Reproducer steps in the incident logs.
Sam H: For speed, we'll keep split routing until we confirm stable for 30m. Increasing backup weight if errors persist.
PagerDuty: INC-3111 acknowledged by Sam H.
Maria G: Customer impact note: 2 larger accounts affected (A and B). A wants SLA impact estimate. CS is coordinating.
Lee W: taking over at 3111115000 for handoff. Sam — brief status: kernel fallback enabled, reimage done, routing at primary:65 backup:35, batcher scaled down, core dumps collected in /var/crash/INC-3111.
Sam H: leaving notes: upload stack traces + core dumps to https://redwood.prod/logs/INC-3111, added temporary feature-flag to routing to allow instant revert.
Runtime Eng: Root cause suspected: regression in quant_kern.so introduced by 2026-02-28 build that mishandles KV cache growth with XLA-like attention optimization. Plan: rollback kernel module to 2026-02-20 build on canaries, run full load test.
Infra SRE: Rolling rollback scheduled on canaries now; if stable, will roll to cluster.
Support Ops: Communicated ETA to customers: full recovery target = 2 hours.
CS Rep: I’ll follow up with account leads and share postmortem commit.
Lee W: Action items captured: collect core dumps, block bad quant_kern build in CI, add circuit-breaker to routing to auto-failover if 5xx > 10% for 5m, add kernel compatibility gate to canary pipeline. I’ll own postmortem.
Oncall Bot: Severity lowered to P2 for INC-3111. Next update from Lee W in 60m. :white_check_mark:
